brief.title: FoundationDB leaks one temp database per instance: 9,018 ns_foundation_*.db files in %TEMP%
brief.next_action: When path is None, register the created temp file for removal at interpreter exit and remove it in close(); never touch a caller-supplied path. Add two tests: the auto path is registered, a supplied path is untouched. Then quarantine the existing 9,018 files in one move (same volume) instead of deleting them.
